# Hecate

> Hecate is a modular, contract-first web API framework for Lua 5.5, with its own
> asynchronous runtime (libuv via luv), HTTP stack, schemas, OpenAPI 3.1 generation,
> test framework, documentation generator, database drivers, ORM and CLI. Status:
> specification stage, no implementation yet.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, components, Lua compatibility
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): rules and workflow for AI agents
- [Vision](docs/vision.md): goals, non-goals, principles
- [Developer experience](docs/developer-experience.md): target user experience with examples
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): mandatory academic vocabulary
- [Roadmap](docs/roadmap.md): phases and exit criteria
- [Open questions](docs/open-questions.md): undecided points

## Website pages (English source in `website/en/`)

- [Connect and serve over TCP](website/en/how-to/connect-and-serve-over-tcp.md): connect, accept loop, reader and writer, half-close, name resolution
- [TLS client and server](website/en/how-to/tls-client-and-server.md): system trust store, private authority, two-step accept, mutual TLS, error reasons
- [Deadlines and cancellation on streams](website/en/how-to/deadlines-and-cancellation.md): what each cancelled operation leaves behind
- [UDP, Unix sockets, named pipes and DNS](website/en/how-to/udp-pipes-and-dns.md): the transports other than TCP
- [Run child processes and pass connections between processes](website/en/how-to/run-processes-and-pass-connections.md): `run_process`, `spawn`, the message pipe
- [The transport model](website/en/explanation/transport-model.md): streams, back-pressure, half-close, buffering, cancellation rules
- [TLS trust and security defaults](website/en/explanation/tls-trust-and-security.md): the operating system's verifier, what cannot be disabled
- [Multi-process serving](website/en/explanation/multi-process-serving.md): share-nothing workers, listening strategies, what exists today
- [Glossary (public copy)](website/en/reference/glossary.md): the vocabulary, kept in step with `docs/glossary.md`

## Packages

- [Package catalogue](packages/README.md): every package with layer, phase and summary
<!-- gen-llms-txt:begin -->
- [hecate-core](packages/core/README.md): Object model (classes, traits, interfaces), error hierarchy, enumerations, value objects and Lua-version compatibility shims.
- [hecate-json](packages/json/README.md): Fast, correct JSON codec (RFC 8259) with integer/float fidelity, explicit null and array markers, and precise error positions.
- [hecate-log](packages/log/README.md): Structured logging with RFC 5424 severities, per-scope context and pluggable sinks.
- [hecate-net](packages/net/README.md): TCP/UDP streams, DNS resolution, buffered readers/writers and TLS, all suspending transparently.
- [hecate-reactor](packages/reactor/README.md): The reactor over libuv (luv): coroutine scheduler, futures, structured concurrency, synchronisation primitives, timers, signals, processes, file system.
- [hecate-http](packages/http/README.md): HTTP/1.1 server and client with a message model following RFC 9110 semantics.
- [hecate-router](packages/router/README.md): Radix-tree router over URI templates (RFC 6570 level-1 subset) with 404/405 handling and reverse routing.
- [hecate-schema](packages/schema/README.md): Refinement types, composition, coercion and validation with JSON Pointer error paths; emits JSON Schema 2020-12.
- [hecate-config](packages/config/README.md): Layered configuration (defaults, environment files, environment variables, secrets) validated by schemas at boot.
- [hecate-container](packages/container/README.md): Inversion-of-control container: bindings, lifetimes (singleton, scoped, transient), constructor injection, cycle detection at boot.
- [hecate-kernel](packages/kernel/README.md): The application: modules, controllers, route modules, filters (chain of responsibility), problem details, lifecycle, workers and graceful shutdown.
- [hecate-openapi](packages/openapi/README.md): OpenAPI 3.1 document assembly from the route table, schemas and project settings; served endpoint, export, lint and breaking-change diff.
- [hecate-cli](packages/cli/README.md): The `hecate` command: toolchains, projects, dependencies (LuaRocks), development server, tests, contracts, documentation, migrations, scaffolding, packaging.
- [hecate-doc](packages/doc/README.md): Documentation generator and static site builder with an MDN-like theme: guides in Markdown, code reference from LuaLS annotations, API reference from OpenAPI, configuration and error-code references, locales, search.
- [hecate-test](packages/test/README.md): xUnit test framework running inside the reactor: cases, suites, fixtures, assertions, in-process HTTP client, contract conformance, property-based testing, coverage.
- [hecate](packages/hecate/README.md): Meta-rock `hecate`: depends on the standard edition and provides the `hecate` meta-module re-exporting the framework surface.
- [hecate-migration](packages/migration/README.md): Versioned, reversible schema migrations with checksums and CLI integration.
- [hecate-mysql](packages/mysql/README.md): MySQL and MariaDB driver implementing the client/server protocol in Lua, with dialect detection.
- [hecate-orm](packages/orm/README.md): Object-relational mapper: Data Mapper with Unit of Work, Identity Map, associations and repositories.
- [hecate-postgresql](packages/postgresql/README.md): PostgreSQL driver implementing the frontend/backend protocol v3 in Lua.
- [hecate-query](packages/query/README.md): Query builder using relational-algebra vocabulary (projection, selection, join, rename, union) rendered per SQL dialect.
- [hecate-redis](packages/redis/README.md): Redis client (RESP3 with RESP2 fallback), compatible with Valkey and KeyDB.
- [hecate-sql](packages/sql/README.md): Driver-agnostic SQL interfaces: drivers, connections, prepared statements, transactions and savepoints, connection pool, type mapping, instrumentation.
- [hecate-sqlite](packages/sqlite/README.md): SQLite driver: C binding to the vendored amalgamation, executed on the libuv thread pool.
- [hecate-websocket](packages/websocket/README.md): WebSocket protocol (RFC 6455) server and client integrated with the kernel.
- [hecate-security](packages/security/README.md): Authentication (bearer tokens, JWT, sessions), authorisation policies, password hashing.
- [hecate-template](packages/template/README.md): Compiled templates with contextual auto-escaping, for HTML and text responses.
- [hecate-mongodb](packages/mongodb/README.md): MongoDB driver (OP_MSG + BSON) and document mapper sharing the unit-of-work vocabulary.
- [hecate-sqlserver](packages/sqlserver/README.md): Microsoft SQL Server driver implementing TDS in Lua.
<!-- gen-llms-txt:end -->
